top_categories.workout_context: 1211 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
At Race Around Netherlands, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
22,966ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Race Around Netherlands' mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Race Around Netherlands' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
1211 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 22,966ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

Road-specific control matters at Race Around Netherlands. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 1211 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 1211 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
22,966ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Race Around Netherlands. Train it until it feels boring.
Low-cadence force work supports 22,966ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 1211-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Over Under, and Mixed Climbing to prepare you for 1211 miles of mixed terrain in Amerongen, Netherlands (fixed anticlockwise loop).
